questions.text: Which single element scrolls in this view, and on which axis? What happens at its edge?
Pre-mortem: this flow broke in production. List the error, cancel, timeout, reload and double-submit paths and the state after each.
What is the view's ready state, and which transition sets the scroll position? What stops auto-follow?
What sizes the shell: dvh/svh or vh? What does the keyboard do (interactive-widget)?
Which overlays can stack here, who owns the stack, and what does Esc close first?
For each state item: where is its one source of truth (URL, server or local)? What happens if two requests overlap?
Which effects subscribe, append, poll or start timers, and what cleans each up on unmount and on a double mount?
For each interactive element: its signifier (cursor, hover, focus), its target size and its placement relative to the pointer.
Does anything appear, disappear or change size when async data arrives? Where is its space reserved?
What reads device or time values, and does the first client render equal the server render?
Which device and viewport matrix will prove it, and which part can only be checked on a real device?

budgets.measure: sum of layout-shift entries without hadRecentInput during load and status changes
DOM target-size scan; 44 for primary touch actions
DOM audit of overflowing auto/scroll elements per view

rules.title: 100vh / h-screen sizing (sits under mobile toolbars and keyboards)
rules.why: vh equals the large viewport, so the bottom of the shell hides under browser toolbars and the keyboard.
rules.confirm: render: Pixel/iPhone emulation, focus the input, assert its bottom <= visualViewport.height
rules.fixHint: dvh/svh (h-dvh, min-h-svh) and an explicit interactive-widget choice

rules.title: Magic z-index number (3+ digits)
rules.why: z-index arms races put modals behind other layers; there is no stack owner.
rules.confirm: failing-test: open A then B; elementFromPoint at B's centre is B; Esc closes B only
rules.fixHint: the top layer (<dialog>.showModal) or a token scale owned by one overlay manager

rules.title: scrollIntoView in a mount-only effect (runs before the content is there)
rules.why: It runs while the skeleton shows, so the view never lands on the latest item.
rules.confirm: failing-test: delay the data 1.5 s; after the skeleton goes, assert distance to bottom < 2 px
rules.fixHint: scroll on the transition to ready, re-assert while height settles, stop at the first user scroll

rules.title: overflow:auto inside another scroll container
rules.why: Three scrollbars, a list that will not scroll, jumps on status change.
rules.confirm: render: DOM audit counts > 1 overflowing scroller per view

rules.title: onClick on a div/span with no role, tabIndex, cursor or keyboard support
rules.why: No signifier, no keyboard access, often a tiny target.
rules.confirm: render: cursor and target-size scan; axe

rules.title: Primary action rendered only when data arrives ({data && <Button/>})
rules.why: The button appears late and shifts the layout.
rules.confirm: measurement: CLS during load over budget

rules.title: Overlay opened with no close in catch/finally
rules.why: A failed call leaves an overlay over the whole UI.
rules.confirm: failing-test: abort the call; assert no [aria-modal=true] left and the page is interactive

rules.title: window/localStorage/matchMedia/Date read in render
rules.why: Server and client render differ: hydration errors and flicker.
rules.confirm: render: built app route crawl with a non-UTC timezone; console has hydration errors

rules.title: fetch in an effect without abort or stale guard
rules.why: A slow old response overwrites the newer selection.
rules.confirm: failing-test: A delayed 1500 ms, B 100 ms; B stays shown

rules.title: Effect that appends to state or the DOM with no cleanup, or with the appended state in its own dependencies
rules.why: Each render or remount adds another copy: elements multiply and the page slows down.
rules.confirm: failing-test: mount, wait 2 s, remount twice; the element count stays constant

rules.title: Menu or popover placed with pointer coordinates against a scrolled or transformed ancestor
rules.why: The menu opens far from the pointer as soon as the container scrolls or moves.
rules.confirm: render: open it at 4 pointer positions inside a scrolled container; the distance from the pointer is over 8 px
rules.fixHint: position against the viewport or with a positioning library (virtual element at the pointer)

rules.title: URL or route written from an effect before the data it depends on (session, permissions) has loaded
rules.why: The early write is read back as a new request and the deep link bounces somewhere else.
rules.confirm: failing-test: delay that data 1.5 s and open a deep link; the final URL equals the deep link

verify.text: run on the production build; dev-mode hydration and CLS differ
Pixel 7, iPhone 13, iPad, desktop 1440; non-UTC timezone and a second locale; light and dark
per route: console clean, scrollers <= 1, no horizontal overflow, target-size and cursor scans, with the longest real content and with an empty state
per flow: race test, error-path matrix (abort and 500), reload-resume, overlay stack (Esc order, focus return)
real-device spot check of anything the keyboard touches, or say 'not verified on device'
